title: quercus spicata f. gracilipes
intro: Quercus spicata f. gracilipes, commonly known as the coast oak or California live oak, is a subspecies of evergreen tree that is native to the southwestern region of North America. This tree is prized for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its high levels of antioxidants and flavonoids. The therapeutic actions of Quercus spicata f. gracilipes include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular-protective effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as polyphenols and tannins. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been shown to have potential therapeutic benefits for various health conditions, including neuroprotection and antimicrobial activities.
